outcomes.outcome: the CLI, its library configured from Hiera and its Python packages are installed, and the CLI starts
an empty, usable user database in the master's manifests after the first run
the administrator adds a user, unlocks it and sets its password with the CLI, and the CLI authenticates it
the server's next agent run leaves the database as the administrator left it (replace no)
another machine gets the user, its name, its password and its SSH key from the database through the master's catalog
a user the administrator locks or expires is refused on the other machine and gets no SSH key there; a deleted user leaves the database
every notifying CLI command (useradd, unlock, setpw, auth, lock, expire, userdel) mails the support team its result, through the local MTA
without hashman_web, the CLI refuses the commands that mail the user (useradd without SILENT, inform) and changes nothing
the mails to the user themselves (a new user's initial password, reset, inform, testemail)
